Prompt Template

  • CURIE: gmeow:PromptTemplate
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PromptTemplate
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/ai

A reusable, versioned prompt with unfilled variables — the published artifact (ships the claim-extraction template as data, not code). Concrete prompts link back via gmeow:filledFrom.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Prompt

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:PromptTemplate as a specialized kind of gmeow:Prompt. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
